```{r}
#| output: false

# Load packages
library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(strex)
library(knitr)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
#| output: false

######################
### Authentication ###
######################

# Fetch the key from the system environment
gcp_key <- Sys.getenv("GCP_SA_KEY")

if (nzchar(gcp_key)) {
  # Authenticate using the github secret key
  gs4_auth(path = gcp_key)
  message("Authenticated using GCP Service Account Secret")
} else {
  # Authenticate using a browser if testing locally
  gs4_auth()
  message("Authenticated via browser.")
}

#################
### Read Data ###
#################

# Sheet ID for reservation request form responses:
sheet_id <- "1ed3zy3QERXUd7yMlfxtwxqAu3sqhpNWP-TScr1Y_dMM"
sheet_id_older_reservations <- "1nd2EMrJhVLAGLXVK840sgU7gEmqqZci1OvvG7t5Z5Hw"

reservations <- read_sheet(sheet_id)
older_reservations <- read_sheet(sheet_id_older_reservations)
```

```{r}

##################
### Processing ###
##################

# Subset reservations data to columns of interest
reservations <- reservations %>%
  select(`Requested arrival date`, `Requested departure date`, `Organization's Name`,
         `Description of Event`, `Facility Requested`, 
         `Will your group have VCU students attending?`,`How many VCU students will there be?`, 
         `Will your group have VCU employees attending?`,`How many VCU employees will there be?`,
         `Will your group have Non-VCU affiliated individuals attending?`,
         `How many Non-VCU affiliated individuals will there be?`, 
         `Is your group in the School of Life Sciences and Sustainability`, Status, 
         `Lodge Invoice Amount`, `Education Invoice Amount`, `Research Facility Invoice Amount`,
         `Fee Waived?`, `Waived Reason`)

# Combine old reservation data (pre-google form - based on invoices only) with new
# reservation data
reservations <- rbind(reservations, older_reservations)

# Formatting free text columns from list -> character
reservations$`How many Non-VCU affiliated individuals will there be?` <- as.character(reservations$`How many Non-VCU affiliated individuals will there be?`)
reservations$`How many VCU employees will there be?` <- as.character(reservations$`How many VCU employees will there be?`)
reservations$`How many VCU students will there be?` <- as.character(reservations$`How many VCU students will there be?`)


# Calculate additional columns and filter unfulfilled reservation requests:
reservations <- reservations %>%
  filter(Status == "Approved") %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate number of days requested
    length_of_stay_days = as.numeric(difftime(`Requested departure date`, `Requested arrival date`, units = "days")) + 1,
    
    # Extract year
    year = year(`Requested arrival date`),
    
    # Approximate count of VCU students from free text response
    count_vcu_students_low = str_first_number(`How many VCU students will there be?`),
    count_vcu_students_high = str_last_number(`How many VCU students will there be?`),
    count_vcu_students_mean = round((count_vcu_students_low + count_vcu_students_high)/2),
    
    # Approximate count of VCU staff/faculty from free text response
    count_vcu_staff_low = str_first_number(`How many VCU employees will there be?`),
    count_vcu_staff_high = str_last_number(`How many VCU employees will there be?`),
    count_vcu_staff_mean = round((count_vcu_staff_low + count_vcu_staff_high)/2),
    
    # Approximate count of non-VCU persons from free text response
    count_non_vcu_low = str_first_number(`How many Non-VCU affiliated individuals will there be?`),
    count_non_vcu_high = str_last_number(`How many Non-VCU affiliated individuals will there be?`),
    count_non_vcu_mean = round((count_non_vcu_low + count_non_vcu_high)/2)

    )

```

# Facility Reservations

```{r}
#| output: false

# Group by number of lodge reservations by year, by status (completed or upcoming)

today <- Sys.Date()
current_year <- as.character(year(today))

lodge_reservations_by_year <- reservations %>%
  filter(grepl("Inger Rice Lodge", `Facility Requested`)) %>%
  mutate(Fulfilled = case_when(`Requested departure date`< today ~ "Completed",
                               `Requested departure date` >= today ~ "Upcoming")) %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year),
         facility = "Lodge") %>%
  group_by(year, Fulfilled, facility) %>%
  summarize(count = n())

education_reservations_by_year <- reservations %>%
  filter(grepl("Rice Education Building's Conference Room", `Facility Requested`)) %>%
  mutate(Fulfilled = case_when(`Requested departure date`< today ~ "Completed",
                               `Requested departure date` >= today ~ "Upcoming")) %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year),
         facility = "Education Building") %>%
  group_by(year, Fulfilled, facility) %>%
  summarize(count = n())

combined_reservations_by_year <- rbind(lodge_reservations_by_year, education_reservations_by_year)

fig01 <- combined_reservations_by_year %>% filter(year == "2026") %>%
  group_by(Fulfilled) %>%
  arrange(Fulfilled) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~facility,
    y = ~count,
    color = ~Fulfilled,
    colors = c("#006894", "#9BBFCE"),
    type = "bar",
    legendgroup = ~Fulfilled
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "2026")
  ) 

fig02 <- combined_reservations_by_year %>% filter(year == "2027") %>%
  group_by(Fulfilled) %>%
  arrange(Fulfilled) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~facility,
    y = ~count,
    color = ~Fulfilled,
    colors = c("#9BBFCE"),
    type = "bar",
    legendgroup = ~Fulfilled,
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "2027")
  ) 
 
```



```{r}

subplot(fig01, fig02, titleX=TRUE, shareY=TRUE) %>%
  layout(barmode = "stack", title = "Number of Facility Reservations", showlegend=TRUE)

```

```{r}

# Calculate number of days reserved for the current year
lodge_usage_days <- reservations %>%
  filter(grepl("Inger Rice Lodge", `Facility Requested`)) %>%
  filter(year == current_year)
lodge_usage_days <- sum(lodge_usage_days$length_of_stay_days)

education_usage_days <- reservations %>%
  filter(grepl("Rice Education Building's Conference Room", `Facility Requested`)) %>%
  filter(year == current_year)
education_usage_days <- sum(education_usage_days$length_of_stay_days)

```

* In `{r} current_year`, the Inger Rice Lodge was booked for a total of `{r} lodge_usage_days` days.
* In `{r} current_year`, the Rice Education Building's Conference Room was booked for a total of `{r} education_usage_days` days.

```{r}

visitors <- reservations %>%
  filter(year == current_year) %>%
  select(count_vcu_students_mean, count_vcu_staff_mean, count_non_vcu_mean)

total_non_vcu <- sum(visitors$count_non_vcu_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
total_vcu_student <- sum(visitors$count_vcu_students_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
total_vcu_staff <- sum(visitors$count_vcu_staff_mean, na.rm = TRUE)

visitor_vector <- c("VCU Students", "VCU Staff & Faculty", "Non-VCU Individuals")
visitor_vector_count <- c(total_vcu_student, total_vcu_staff, total_non_vcu)

total_visitors <- total_non_vcu + total_vcu_student + total_vcu_staff

```

```{r}

fig03 <- plot_ly(
    x = visitor_vector_count, 
    y = current_year, 
    color = visitor_vector, 
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h",
    width = "100%",

  ) %>%

    autosize = FALSE
  )

fig03
```
